Gallery: Geo

Source: vignettes/articles/gallery-geo.Rmd
gallery-geo.Rmd

本页解决什么问题：Map data with mark_map() + project_map(). 前置：已完成 gallery-proportions

下一步：→ gallery-annotations

library(plotit)

Map support requires sf. mark_map() draws sf polygons; coordinate projection is handled by project_map().

Choropleth 

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
  nc |>
    plotit(encode(fill = AREA)) |>
    mark_map() |>
    scale_fill(range = "viridis") |>
    project_map()
}
#> Scale for fill is already present.
#> Adding another scale for fill, which will replace the existing scale.

Point symbols over a map 

nc |>
  plotit(encode(x = 1, y = 1)) |>
  mark_map(fill = "grey90", colour = "grey50") |>
  mark_point(mapping = encode(x = lon, y = lat), data = nc, size = 0.8)

Recipe: spike / lollipop map (R-16)

mark_spoke on lon/lat (zero-length stems) gives radial bars; overlay it on a mark_map base with project_map.

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  nc |>
    plotit(encode(fill = AREA)) |>
    mark_map() |>
    scale_fill(range = "viridis") |>
    project_map()
}
#> Scale for fill is already present.
#> Adding another scale for fill, which will replace the existing scale.
